name: What are the benefits of having interior window sills?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of having interior window sills?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior window sills offer several practical and aesthetic benefits. They provide a stable surface for decor, plants, or books, enhancing the room's functionality and visual appeal. Sills also protect the wall beneath the window from moisture and general wear, especially in high-traffic areas or near plants that need watering. Beyond protection, they contribute to the architectural trim of a room, creating a finished look. Properly installed sills can also form part of an effective thermal barrier, contributing to energy efficiency by sealing gaps around the window.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior window sills offer stable surfaces for decor, protect walls from moisture and wear, enhance a room's aesthetic trim, and can contribute to energy efficiency.
